versions.changelog: Security review refresh: keep canonical credentials portable across agents, keep OpenClaw-specific secret paths out of the packaged skill, require the documented pre-publish scan gate, and preserve official Open Plantbook API host enforcement for credentialed requests.
Restrict the packaged helper to the official Open Plantbook API host for credentialed requests and document the host-safety behavior.
Add NVIDIA-style skill card with grower-focused use cases, risks, evaluation notes, and credential guidance.
Initial ClawHub release: plant search, care-detail lookup, saved-plant creation helper, credential handling, and publishing notes.
